fields.label: Enable Additional Charges
fields.description: Master switch. When off, no document posts charges.

fields.label: Require Cost Center
fields.description: Enforce a cost center on income/expense charge accounts.

fields.label: Enable Item Discounts
fields.description: Two cascading percentages and an extra amount per unit on each item row. Results are written into ERPNext's own price list rate, discount amount and rate fields.

fields.label: Discount Method
fields.options:
Keep Rate (discount on net amount)
Reduce Rate
fields.description: Keep Rate: Rate and Amount stay as entered; the discount lowers the line's net amount, VAT and income, and shows as the document's discount (ERPNext v16). Reduce Rate: the discount is taken off the Rate.

fields.label: Discount Rounding
fields.description: Reduce Rate only. ZATCA-safe keeps gross rate, discount and net rate at two decimals so the e-invoice price block always reconciles.

fields.label: Default Discount Reason
fields.description: Filled on any discounted line without a reason.

fields.label: Discount Authority
fields.description: Leave empty for no limits. When filled, the user who submits must hold a role whose limit covers every discounted line. Drafts save freely.

fields.label: ZATCA Integration
fields.description: On Sales and POS Invoices: tick the invoice's line-discount flag, fill the discount reason code and text, and block combinations ZATCA rejects. Acts only when a ZATCA app or its fields are present.

fields.label: Several Reasons on One Invoice
fields.options:
Use the reason with the largest discount
Block saving
fields.default: Use the reason with the largest discount

fields.label: Block Tax-Table Charges on ZATCA Invoices
fields.description: Rejects charge lines with Add To other than None on Sales Invoices when a ZATCA app is installed. ZATCA apps read the taxes table as VAT, so a charge row there would be reported as tax.

fields.options:
Additional charges post a standalone, self-balancing Journal Entry referencing the source document, unless 'Add To' sends them into the document's own taxes table. Quotation, Sales Order, Supplier Quotation and Purchase Order do not post GL entries of their own: charges raised there create an accrual, and entering the same charge on the downstream invoice posts it twice.

Payable and Receivable accounts require a Party. All other account types must not carry one.

Item discounts, Keep Rate: Rate and Amount are not changed. Each line's discount lowers its net amount through ERPNext's per-item discount, and the total shows as the document's Additional Discount on Net Total. It cannot be combined with a manually entered Additional Discount. Reduce Rate: the gross rate goes into Price List Rate, the discount per unit into Discount Amount and the net rate into Rate; pricing rules and margins cannot be combined with it on the same line. Item → Max Discount is enforced against the effective discount.

For discount GL postings per reason, enable Selling Settings → Enable Discount Accounting and set accounts on each Discount Reason.
